bluetooth.notes: Exact default name NOT confirmed from an official source. Samsung's manual and support pages only say to select the earbuds in the Bluetooth list; SoundGuys calls them 'Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro'. The open-source GalaxyBudsClient identifies this model by the substring 'Buds3 Pro' in the device name (and notes Buds2+ can be renamed, so it prefers the Samsung SPP service UUID d908aab5-7a90-4cbe-8641-86a553db... for model detection). Previous Galaxy Buds used 'Galaxy Buds<model> (XXXX)' with a 4-hex-digit suffix; assumed here, verify on device. Match 'Buds3 Pro' BEFORE plain 'Buds3' to avoid confusing it with the Galaxy Buds3. 0x0075 is Samsung Electronics' Bluetooth SIG company ID (assigned-numbers list); that the Buds3 Pro advertise with it is not verified. Pairing mode: case battery LED flashes red, green and blue; blade lights may flash. Pairing mode times out after 3 minutes. Google Fast Pair support not confirmed (Samsung phones use their own pop-up; non-Samsung Android uses the Galaxy Wearable app).

pairingSteps: On the Android phone, turn on Bluetooth and install the Galaxy Wearable app from Google Play (recommended for non-Samsung phones).
Put both earbuds into their correct slots in the charging case.

Close the case and open it again. The earbuds go into pairing mode. If they don't, keep the case open and press and hold the Connect button on the bottom of the case for more than 3 seconds, until the case light flashes red, green and blue.
On a Samsung phone, tap Connect on the pop-up. On other Android phones, open Galaxy Wearable and follow the on-screen steps, or on Android 16 or later select the earbuds in Settings > Bluetooth.
If the phone doesn't connect within 3 minutes, pairing mode turns off. Close and reopen the case to start again.
